commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+1' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Jose Sanchez due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) and his team.
90+1' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
88' Referee Jose Sanchez sees the trip by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
86' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
85' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Sanchez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
83' The corner from Joan Jordan (Alaves) is hurriedly cleared.
83' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kike Garcia (Alaves).
81' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
80' Kike Garcia (Alaves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Sanchez saw the whole situation.
78' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) replaces Nico Williams.
78' It's time for a substitution. Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) comes on in place of Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
76' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
75' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
74' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Sanchez no option but to blow his whistle.
73' Substitution. Antonio Blanco will be replaced by Ander Guevara (Alaves).
72' A pass by Carlos Vicente (Alaves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
69' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) will miss the next game.
69' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
68' The referee blows his whistle as Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) was too aggressive in his challenge.
67' 1 - 1 Goal! Joan Jordan (Alaves) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
67' Jon Guridi (Alaves) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Unai Simon as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
63' Dangerous play by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao). Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
61' It is time for a substitution. Stoichkov (Alaves) is on for Carlos Martin.
60' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Alex Berenguer and he is replaced by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
60' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Unai Gomez is replaced by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao).
59' The linesman raises his flag. Joan Jordan (Alaves) is adjudged offside.
59' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
58' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
54' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
53' The attendance is 19239.
49' Jose Sanchez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Carlos Martin (Alaves).
48' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Joan Jordan (Alaves), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
47' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) heads on.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Ernesto Valverde gives a chance to Yuri Berchiche and Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) is off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+2' Carlos Martin (Alaves) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
45+1' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) makes a strong challenge and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
43' Jose Sanchez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao).
43' Carlos Martin (Alaves) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jose Sanchez blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
40' Good movement by Joan Jordan (Alaves), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
36' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is caught offside!
34' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
33' The resulting corner from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is cleared by the defence.
27' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
26' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Antonio Sivera thwarts him with a nice save.
24' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
21' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Joan Jordan (Alaves), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
20' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
19' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Sanchez blows for a foul.
17' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul after Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) hacks down one of his opponents.
14' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
12' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

10' 0 - 1 Brilliant finish! Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Inaki Williams, then produced a nice strike into the bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
9' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends in a close-range first-time shot. It's a poor effort which sails miles wide of the left post.
7' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul.

6' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post.
5' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle. Moussa Diarra (Alaves) commits a foul after dangerous play.
4' Kike Garcia (Alaves) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
1' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
